# Toolchain hashing recognizes a separate comm Git checkout by its marker

hash_paths selects the comm-aware helper when either GECKO/comm/.hg or GECKO/comm/.git exists; otherwise it delegates to the Gecko-root helper. os.path.exists also accepts a marker file. get_digest_data passes the root and its actual resource paths to that wrapper. The local extended helper separates comm patterns and uses two finders. This establishes branch selection in comm source, not imported finder semantics, arbitrary checkout support or cache correctness. No changed tests or live hashing run occurred.

Scope: Thunderbird taskgraph toolchain resource hashing.
